    StartersXavier's School cereal barsAsk Storm what happens to a toad struck by lightningHow to make it60g butter80g honey100g peanut butter150g rolled oats80g puffed rice cerealMelt the butter, honey and peanut butter together.Stir through the oats and puffed rice until coated.Press firmly into a lined tin.Chill, then cut into bars.Iceman frozen grapesRed and green grapes rolled in lime juice and sugar, frozen solidHow to make it250g red grapes250g green grapes1 lime50g caster sugarPick the grapes off the stem, wash and dry.Roll in the lime juice, then in the sugar.Spread on a tray and freeze until solid. Serve straight from the freezer.Main trayCage fight poutineAnything goes in the cage. Chips, curds and hot beef gravyHow to make it1kg potatoes2 L vegetable oil40g butter3 tbsp plain flour500ml beef stock250g cheese curdsCut the potatoes into chips.Fry in the oil at 140°C until soft and pale.Cook the butter and flour for 2 minutes, whisk in the stock and simmer until thick.Fry the chips again in the oil at 185°C until crisp.Pile chips into bowls, scatter the cheese curds and pour the hot gravy over.Liberty Island summit roast chickenDry-brined bird, zesty herb butter under the skin, crunchy potatoes, garlicky beans, pan gravyHow to make itNot on tonight's cookDry-brined chicken with lemon and thyme butter under the skin, roasted golden, with crunchy roast potatoes, garlicky green beans and pan gravy.Salt a 1.8kg chicken and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.Push 50g butter mashed with lemon zest and thyme under the breast skin.Roast at 220°C for 20 minutes, then 180°C for 50 minutes, with 1kg halved potatoes in oil around it.Rest 10 minutes.Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.Blanch 300g green beans and toss with butter and 1 sliced garlic clove.PuddingFrozen ice creamIceman's idea of pudding, hot chocolate set hard on topHow to make it1 L very hard vanilla ice cream150g dark chocolate2 tbsp coconut oilPut four bowls in the freezer.Scoop the ice cream into the bowls.Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil and pour over at the table so it sets into a shell in seconds.DrinksLogan's rye and maple old fashionedRye over one big ice cube, for the road out of Alberta with RogueHow to make it240ml Canadian rye whisky4 tsp maple syrup8 dashes of aromatic bitters1 orange4 large ice cubes2 cups ice, for stirringStir the rye, maple syrup and bitters over ice in a jug until very cold.Strain into four heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each.Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim and drop it in.
